app.title: SnapTunes - From Snap to Sound
app.description: Create music playlists instantly from images or text with SnapTunes. Powered by AI and OCR, we turn your moments into music.
app.keywords: SnapTunes, AI playlist generator, OCR music app, image to music, text to playlist, Spotify, Apple Music

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: SnapTunes prioritizes the protection of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how personal information is collected, used, and protected when using SnapTunes services.

collection.title: 1. Personal Information We Collect
collection.content:
SnapTunes may collect the following information to provide services:
• Music service authentication information (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music)
• Uploaded images and text (not stored on SnapTunes server, sent to OpenAI API for real-time processing and discarded)
• Service usage records and playlist creation information
• Device information and access logs

usage.title: 2. How We Use Personal Information
usage.content:
Collected personal information is used only for the following purposes:
• Music service integration and playlist creation
• Service quality improvement and user experience enhancement
• Customer support and inquiry response
• Legal obligation compliance

sharing.title: 3. Sharing and Disclosure of Personal Information
sharing.content:
SnapTunes does not provide your personal information to third parties except in the following cases:
• When you give explicit consent
• When required by law
• When sharing minimal necessary information with music service providers for service delivery
• When sending images and text to OpenAI API for analysis (not stored)

security.title: 4. Personal Information Protection Measures
security.content:
We implement the following security measures to protect personal information:
• Encrypted communication and data storage
• Access control and monitoring
• Regular security audits and updates

retention.title: 5. Personal Information Retention and Disposal
retention.content: Personal information is disposed of immediately after the purpose of service provision is achieved. However, it may be retained for the period required by relevant laws and regulations.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.content:
You have the following rights:
• Request to access and correct personal information
• Request to delete personal information
• Request to stop processing personal information
• Request to transfer personal information

contact.title: 7. Inquiries and Contact Information
contact.content:
If you have any questions regarding personal information processing, please contact us at:
• Email: snaptunesapp@gmail.com
• This Privacy Policy may be modified for service improvements, and significant changes will be notified in advance.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.introduction: Thank you for using SnapTunes services. These Terms of Service define the conditions and rules related to using SnapTunes services.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By using this service, you are deemed to have agreed to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to the terms, you must discontinue using the service.

service.title: 2. Service Description
service.content:
SnapTunes provides the following services:
• Automatic music playlist generation based on images and text
• Integration with various music services (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music)
• AI-based music recommendations and analysis

usage.title: 3. Service Usage Rules
usage.content:
When using the service, you must comply with the following:
• Respect copyright and intellectual property rights
• Do not infringe on others' rights
• Do not interfere with normal service operation
• Do not upload illegal or inappropriate content

accounts.title: 4. Accounts and Authentication
accounts.content: Music service integration requires authentication with the respective service accounts. Users must securely manage their account information and prevent unauthorized use.

liability.title: 5. Liability and Disclaimers
liability.content:
SnapTunes is not liable in the following cases:
• Damages due to user negligence
• Failures or errors of third-party music services
• Service interruption due to force majeure

intellectual.title: 6. Intellectual Property Rights
intellectual.content: All intellectual property rights related to SnapTunes services belong to SnapTunes. Users are prohibited from unauthorized copying, distribution, or modification of the service.

modification.title: 7. Terms Modification
modification.content: These terms may be modified for service improvements. Significant changes will be notified in advance, and modified terms take effect immediately upon notification.

governing.title: 8. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
governing.content: These terms are interpreted according to the laws of the Republic of Korea.
